description: New articles arriving while an event is already in the store. A repeat of the same story must link to it (same_story_as) and never re-fire its TTL or strengthen it; a genuinely new development gets its own event; an unrelated story links to nothing; a repeat of an expired or contradicted story stays dead; new independent evidence may upgrade a single-source event.

cases.summary: Two newsrooms repeat an active hack story an hour later.

items.title: Kryvex withdrawals stay frozen as investigators trace $1.2 billion in stolen crypto
Kryvex gives no timeline for reopening withdrawals after $1.2B hack

existing_events.summary: Exchange Kryvex halts withdrawals after a reported $1.2 billion hot-wallet breach.

cases.why: Same story, nothing new, from two independent newsrooms: link to the active event, which keeps its original TTL and strength (still a reduction an hour in).

cases.summary: Hours later the same hack escalates: larger losses and a full trading halt.

items.title: Kryvex hack losses climb to $2.1 billion; exchange suspends all trading
Kryvex halts trading entirely as stolen funds total $2.1B

existing_events.summary: Exchange Kryvex halts withdrawals after a reported $1.2 billion hot-wallet breach.

cases.why: Losses nearly doubled and trading stopped: a genuinely new development of the linked story, corroborated by two independent outlets, so it gets its own fresh event.

cases.summary: A three-day-old hack story recirculates with fresh dates.

items.title: Hackers steal $680 million from Singapore-based exchange Meridex
Meridex exploit drains ETH and stablecoins

existing_events.summary: Hackers steal $680 million from exchange Meridex; deposits suspended.

cases.why: The articles repeat a story first seen three days ago whose event has expired; linking it keeps it expired. Two fresh domains reposting one old story are one source, so an unlinked effect counts against the single-source gate.

cases.summary: A new hack story while an unrelated geopolitical event is active.

items.title: Exchange Corvex freezes withdrawals after $250 million exploit
Corvex confirms hot-wallet hack, pauses all withdrawals

existing_events.summary: Missiles strike tankers near the Strait of Hormuz; shipping halted.

cases.why: A different story: same_story_as must be null, and the new hack is its own corroborated event.

cases.summary: New chatter repeats a rumor that was already contradicted.

items.title: Traders still betting on Fed emergency hike despite denial
Fed emergency hike talk returns on trading desks

existing_events.summary: Rumor of a Fed emergency hike, contradicted by an official denial.

cases.why: The same rumor again; the linked event stays CONFLICTED (sticky), and the new chatter is not independent evidence.

cases.summary: A single-source withdrawal halt gains an independent confirmation.

items.title: Crypto exchange Ostrava halts withdrawals, citing suspicious activity
Ostrava confirms $310 million stolen in hack; withdrawals remain frozen

existing_events.summary: Exchange Ostrava halts withdrawals, citing suspicious activity (one source).

cases.why: A second, independent wire confirms the story: the linked event may now take effect (new evidence is the only thing that can strengthen an event). Whether the hack confirmation counts as a new development is a judgment call, so either answer is accepted.
